audit_standard: BKRS v1.0 Step 4.0 Canonical Reader / Renderer Forensic Audit
benchmark_target: Satvinder S. Juss, Bhagat Singh: A Life in Revolution (2022) & Shared Multi-Genre Reading Interface

verdicts.reusability_score: HIGH (Shell & CSS reusable; View engines require extension and refactoring)

shared_infrastructure.layout_shell: 95% Reusable (reader-shell.css topbar, sidebar, viewport, modal, drawer)
shared_infrastructure.interaction_controller: Partially Reusable (reader-controls.js requires event-binding and element-ID reconciliation)

genre_specific_payloads.fiction: Scene, What Happens, Texture, Dialogue Subtext, Emotional Shift, Motifs
genre_specific_payloads.nonfiction: Argument, Thesis Claim, Logical Chain, Empirical Studies, Heuristic, Models
genre_specific_payloads.historical_biographical: Historical/Life Episode, Document Unit, Dual Timeline, Causal DAG, Forensic Evidence, Competing Accounts, Epistemic Demarcation

current_renderer_defects.description: bkrs_adapter.js misidentifies historical_biography as fiction and collapses all chapters into Chapter 1 due to chapter property key mismatch.
render_fiction.js and render_nonfiction.js contain hardcoded book-specific content in View B and View C instead of deriving from knowledge-units.json.
Element ID and JavaScript handler mismatch between render_bkrs_book.js (inline handlers) and reader-controls.js (addEventListener to non-matching IDs).
Absence of historical epistemic badge styles and causal relationship edge renderers.

implementation_sequence: Step 4.1: Reconcile Shared Shell & Interaction IDs (reader-controls.js, reader-shell.css)
Step 4.2: Extend Universal Adapter Layer (bkrs_adapter.js) to support historical_biography schema, dual timelines, causal relationships, and plates
Step 4.3: Implement Specialized Historical Renderer Engine (src/bkrs/render_historical.js) with dynamic View A, View B, and View C
Step 4.4: Wire Historical Engine into Universal Entry Point (src/render_bkrs_book.js)
Step 4.5: Compile and Verify Juss Reader (docs/distillations/bhagat-singh-a-life-in-revolution/index.html)
